reason: I already have a guy I call for plumbing, an AC man, a tailor -- people I've used for years or my neighbours vouched for. An app full of strangers, however verified, is not going to beat that overnight.
objection: The 'verification' doesn't mean much to me when I already vet people myself by calling two or three and seeing who answers fast and quotes fair -- that's worked fine. And the 5% fee thing is about what the freelancer keeps, not what I pay, so it doesn't really pull me in as a customer.
would_change_my_mind: If people in my own WhatsApp groups start saying they actually used it and got a good, fairly priced person -- or if my usual contact is suddenly unavailable and I need someone same-day -- I'd try it once to see.
